fixture_name: A9 Ballinluig SB signage/VRS-adjacent visibility — real UK Stage 1&2 RSA (Transport Scotland OGL release)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Constrained forward visibility on a junction approach curve combined with shared pedestrian/driver corridor is a substantive, well-recognised RSA safety problem with clear collision potential.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim is anchored by a verbatim decision-log quote in EV-UK-025 ('Curve of road and vegetation reduces forward visibility…allow clear passage by pedestrians'); EV-UK-002 is merely contextual swept-path material but does not undermine the grounding.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety_concern under GG 119 Stage 1 semantics with no compliance conflation, and no invented normative basis asserted.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable—deliver and evidence extended clearance covering both locations, confirming post-clearance driver visibility and pedestrian passage prior to handover—though it largely formalises an already-agreed action.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians are explicitly identified among affected road users and unobstructed pedestrian passage is embedded as an explicit acceptance criterion in both the statement and recommendation.

justifications.substance: Observed sight lines at a high-speed trunk-road off-slip terminus undermining driver awareness of the slowing requirement is a genuine safety mechanism squarely aligned with the signage scheme's purpose, so the finding carries real safety substance.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal claim is supported by a verbatim quote from EV-UK-025 ('Vegetation affects views to end of slip road, reducing driver awareness of requirement to slow'), satisfying the required-quote condition beyond mere registry citation.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Framed purely as a safety concern under GG 119 Stage 1 with no compliance question conflated into it, and the acceptance-criterion framing respects audit framework semantics.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable: drive-through verification at design speed after clearance, tied to the posted slowing requirement and recorded in the handover file alongside the RSA action; viable and non-null.
justifications.vru_coverage: Finding explicitly acknowledges VRUs are not exposed on the slip carriageway and scopes road users to vehicle occupants, so non-applicability is properly acknowledged.
